findings.cause: base_refresh operations acquired the native Corp advisory lock before the audit ledger row, inverting ordinary audited transactions.
findings.resolution: audited_inner now calls existing lock_ledger before existing aggregate_breaker::lock_corp_tx.
findings.evidence: Three native PostgreSQL tests observe a ledger waiter and then request the Corp lock. All three deadlock on the old order and pass on the corrected order. Adoption and abandonment enable coverage only for the replacement mission.
